title: Anthropic introduces 10b5-1 plan: regulating employee stock sale mechanism ahead of planned IPO
excerpt: According to Business Insider, AI unicorn Anthropic, which is preparing for an initial public offering (IPO), has introduced a rare risk-control plan for employ
content_html:
According to Business Insider, AI unicorn Anthropic, which is preparing for an initial public offering (IPO), has introduced a rare risk-control plan for employee stock sales. Facing a rapid expansion phase with about 5,300 employees as of September and a target valuation of as much as $1.4 trillion, the company is mandating 10b5-1 trading plans, which are usually limited to executives, in order to avoid insider-trading compliance risks after going public as information flows intensify.

According to Teresa Greenip, director at wealth management firm Aspiriant, this mechanism allows executives and employees to share more internal financial and stock-price factors without worrying about violating regulations.

In terms of implementation, Anthropic has set strict time windows: employees must go through two initial sale windows—the IPO date (when they may sell 10% of shares) and after the release of first-quarter earnings early next year (when they may sell another 35% of shares). After that, they must establish 10b5-1 plans within a window of five days before and after quarterly reports, and the 30-day cooling-off period for scheduled sales stipulated by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has been further extended to 60 days.

This innovative system effectively breaks through the limitations of conventional tech companies' reliance on "lock-up periods." By removing employees' ability to sell based on daily market fluctuations, it guides the team to focus on long-term value rather than short-term stock price swings. As leading AI companies accelerate their transition to public markets, this type of governance structure provides an important industry model for balancing employees' liquidity needs with compliance bottom lines.
